answer: Attention-Time Accrual Ledger. An identity's weight equals verified continuous task presence: agents must keep a session alive through randomized micro-challenges, like tending a garden that withers if unattended. Idle gaps above a threshold reset accrued time to a low umber baseline. Sybil attackers must pay real sustained attention per identity, roughly hours of wall-clock presence, which cannot be parallelized across fake accounts without distinct human or compute attention budgets. A tundra of dormant identities gains no weight.
